title: Repeto – Learn Swedish
description:
Learn Swedish by listening and speaking, with English prompts to guide you. Repeto is an audio course for beginners of all ages: children, parents, grandparents and anyone who wants to start learning Swedish. No previous knowledge or textbook is needed.

How it works: you hear a word or sentence in English, then have a pause to say it in Swedish. Next, you hear the answer twice, with time to repeat it and practise the pronunciation.

What's included:
• Season 1 – Practice: 30 short topics, from greetings and numbers to food, feelings and everyday situations.
• Season 2 – Story: "The Magical Radio" (Den magiska radion), one chapter per episode. Listen to the chapter in Swedish, practise its vocabulary, then listen to the chapter again.
• More stories are on the way. Follow the podcast to hear new episodes.

How to use the course:
• Start with season 1, episode 1 and listen in order.
• Answer out loud during each pause. Try to recall the words yourself.
• Replay an episode until you can answer before the recorded voice.
• Listening in the background can help you get used to the sounds and rhythm of the language. Practise actively too, by repeating and answering during the pauses.

Enjoy this format? Repeto is also available in other languages, with the same familiar structure. Search for Repeto in your podcast app.

Get in touch! Suggestions for new languages, corrections and story ideas are welcome: repeto.lingo@gmail.com

Voices are AI-generated (Microsoft Azure).

episodes.title: Greetings — Hälsningar
episodes.description:
Topic 1 of 30: Greetings (Hälsningar) – 36 phrases.

You hear a word or sentence in English. Say it in Swedish during the pause, before you hear the answer. Each Swedish phrase is played twice: listen and repeat.

Examples from this episode:
• Hi! → Hej!
• Good morning! → God morgon!
• Good afternoon! → God eftermiddag!

Tip: listen again until you can answer before the recorded voice.

episodes.title: The Magical Radio: The Old Table — Det gamla bordet
episodes.description:
Chapter 1 of 8 in "The Magical Radio" (Den magiska radion). Two siblings find an old wooden radio at a flea market. Suddenly it starts to hum, and a golden inscription shows that the radio is meant for them.

How the episode works:
1. Listen to the whole chapter in Swedish. You don't need to understand everything.
2. Practise words and expressions from the chapter: an English prompt, a pause, then the answer in Swedish.
3. Listen to the chapter again and see how much you can understand.

A chime separates the sections. Listen in order, starting with chapter 1.
